pages.text: $(li)$(l)Crash on import interface open$() after joining: if the GUI help overlay extends beyond screen bounds, the game crashes. Resize your screen or adjust UI scale before opening.
$(li)$(l)Compacting cell crash$(): occurs when inserting an item card, adding items, then removing the card. Avoid this sequence.

$(li)$(l)Interface polling issues$(): if items/fluids don’t update reliably, temporarily set polling rate to $(5)1$() second, then revert to your preferred value.$(li)$(l)Fluid/item misreporting in subnet view$(): often caused by fluid drawers connected via Storage Bus.
Use a standard Storage Bus instead.

$(li)If items vanish in ME, check for subnets without direct storage—items get poofed if no storage exists on the subnet.$(li)Import and export buses require intermediary storage (disk or storage bus) to function correctly.$(li)AE2 systems do not leak items like chests;
items in ME networks are safe from accidental loss.
